title: Confidential submission of draft S-1 to the SEC
text: Confidential submission of draft S-1 to the SEC | OpenAI Research Products Business Developers Company Foundation Log in Try ChatGPT Research Products Business Developers Company Foundation Try ChatGPT Login OpenAI June 8, 2026 Company Confidential submission of draft S-1 to the SEC Share We recently submitted a confidential S-1. We expect it to leak so we’re just announcing it. We have not decided on timing yet; it may be a while because there are things we want to do that are likely easier as a private company. But it’s a complicated set of tradeoffs and this gives us the option to go public sooner if that ends up being best. This announcement is being made pursuant to Rule 135 under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, and does not constitute an offer to sell or the solicitation of an offer to buy any securities.
